## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `make lint test` passes locally
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-dco))
- [ ] Commit messages follow `area: summary`
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, example config) where behavior or options changed
- [ ] Protocol change? `docs/protocol.md` updated first and the version handled as described there
- [ ] Architectural change? ADR added in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private keys in the diff, logs or screenshots
